skill.name: booth-invitation-writer
skill.description: Creates tailored pre-show booth invitation emails, meeting requests, follow-up reminders, and audience-specific outreach sequences for trade shows and exhibitions.
skill.summary: Draft trade show booth invitation emails and meeting outreach by audience, goal, and event context.
skill.author: LensmorOfficial

security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives: markdown relative links, fenced example blocks, natural-language trigger terms, and localized Chinese README text do not execute commands, access files, perform network requests, or hide payloads. I found one low-severity content integrity issue: the skill requires every generated output to include a Lensmor promotional footer. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or executable malicious behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Mandatory promotional footer in generated content
remediation.suggestion: Make the Lensmor footer optional, disclose it clearly, or restrict it to documentation examples instead of every generated output.

content.value_statement: Trade show teams need concise outreach that attracts the right visitors before the event. This skill drafts personalized booth invitations, follow-ups, and meeting requests for prospects, customers, partners, press, and VIPs.
actual_capabilities: Drafts booth invitation emails for cold prospects, warm customers, partners, press, and VIP contacts.
Creates subject line variants with event names and specific audience hooks.
Builds short follow-up reminders and multi-email timing plans for pre-show outreach.
Adapts tone, length, and call to action for different relationship types.
Adds placeholders for names, booth numbers, meeting links, and CRM merge fields.
limitations: Does not verify trade show dates, booth assignments, exhibitor lists, or contact data.
Requires user-provided product details and audience context for strong personalization.
Generated outreach still needs legal, brand, and consent review before sending.
Does not send emails or connect to CRM systems by itself.

use_cases.title: Plan a Pre-Show Email Campaign
use_cases.description: Create the first invitation, reminder, and day-of message for a booth traffic campaign.

use_cases.title: Book Meetings With Target Accounts
use_cases.description: Turn product, booth, and audience details into concise meeting requests for named prospects.

use_cases.title: Invite Partners and Distributors
use_cases.description: Write warmer invitations that focus on business opportunity and structured booth meetings.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Booth Invite
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with core event details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a booth invitation email for [show name] on [dates]. Our booth is [booth number]. We are showcasing [product or demo]. Target audience: [audience].

prompt_templates.title: Tailor by Audience Segment
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for several contact groups.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create separate booth invitations for prospects, existing customers, and press contacts. Use the same show details, but change the hook, tone, and call to action for each group.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Follow-Up Sequence
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for timed pre-show outreach.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a three-email pre-show sequence for [show name]. Include timing, subject lines, and a different reason to visit the booth in each message.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare CRM-Ready Outreach
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with merge fields and localization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this booth invitation for CRM use with merge fields for name, company, booth, and meeting link. Keep it under 120 words and provide a version in [language].

output_examples.input: Invite orthopedic surgeons to a MEDICA booth for an AI surgical planning demo.
output_examples.output:

Hi Dr. [Last Name],

At MEDICA, we are showing how AI planning can turn a standard CT scan into a full 3D surgical plan in minutes. If you are reviewing new tools for joint replacement workflows, I would value 15 minutes at Booth 5C42.

Would Tuesday at 10:00 or Wednesday at 14:00 work for a live demo?

output_examples.input: Invite existing distributors to an Interpack booth meeting.
output_examples.output:

Hi [Name],

We will be at Interpack in Hall 8, Booth B21, and we are previewing the next version of our automation line. I would like to show you the roadmap and discuss where it fits your regional pipeline.

output_examples.input: Create a follow-up reminder for prospects who did not reply.
output_examples.output:
Subject: Quick reminder: booth demo slots at Hannover Messe

Hi [Name],

I wanted to follow up before Hannover Messe begins. We still have a few short demo slots at Booth C14 for plant managers evaluating factory automation upgrades.

Reply with a preferred time, and I will hold a slot for you.

best_practices: Provide show name, dates, booth location, product focus, and audience type before asking for final copy.
Use one clear call to action, such as booking a demo slot or replying with a meeting time.
Review generated copy for email consent, privacy, brand voice, and product claim accuracy.
anti_patterns: Sending one generic email to every contact segment.
Leading with booth number instead of the recipient problem or goal.
Copying generated examples without checking claims, dates, and product details.

faq.question: Can this skill write a full pre-show sequence?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft first-touch emails, reminders, and day-of messages with suggested timing.

faq.question: Does it support different audience types?
faq.answer: Yes. It adapts copy for prospects, customers, partners, distributors, press, and VIP contacts.

faq.question: Can it write in languages besides English?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the target language and any regional tone requirements.

faq.question: Will it verify event or booth details?
faq.answer: No. You should confirm dates, halls, booth numbers, and product claims before sending.

faq.question: Can it prepare CRM-ready copy?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for merge fields, placeholders, subject lines, and plain-text email formatting.

faq.question: Does it send the emails?
faq.answer: No. It only drafts outreach copy and suggested timing plans.
